headline: AI narrows the gap between lone attackers and state hackers
body: A modest day. Anthropic case studies showed AI letting small actors do more in Russian- and Chinese-linked operations, with humans still choosing targets, which raises Catastrophic Risk and Self-Destruction. OpenAI's new Agents API public beta adds AI Autonomy, nudging Conquerors, Descendants and Zookeeper. Cohere's 50-language translation model slightly eased Power Concentration. Horizon Balance slipped to -3.61.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.2, mostly from Anthropic's attacker case studies (+0.23). Enslaved God -0.2, mostly from Agents API (-0.06) and Cohere's translation model (-0.06). Reversion +0.1, from Anthropic's attacker case studies (+0.08) and fading earlier news (+0.04).
